title: 2009 HMMT November Guts Problem 34
statement: How many hits does "3.1415" get on Google? Quotes are for clarity only, and not part of the search phrase. Also note that Google does not search substrings, so a webpage with 3.14159 on it will not match 3.1415 . If \(A\) is your answer, and \(S\) is the correct answer, then you will get \(\max (25-\mid \ln (A)-\) \(\ln (S) \mid, 0)\) points, rounded to the nearest integer.
